positive_findings: All twelve contract frozen-input paths exist and match their pinned SHA256 values.
The M514 directed VCS package and its independent receipt-blind hammer both pass member manifests and outer seals, and their no-performance/no-PPA boundaries match the M522 runner assertions.
The Tcl uses -define SYNTHESIS, the slow library as target, the fast library as min version, 3 ns constraints, ZeroWireload, and flattening before mapping.

The Tcl places its TIM-209/OPT-150 check before ungroup and compile, and the runner demands five clean constraint classes, mapped netlist/SDC/DDC/SVF, nonnegative setup/hold slack, and a sealed JSON receipt.

The only future positive admission is additive decoder-support logic cost after a clean run; full decoder trace, speedup, energy, physical SRAM, Formality, paper PPA, system speedup, and DATE headline remain false.
The canonical M522 output directory did not exist during review and docs/359 retained the frozen SHA.

p0_findings.finding: The common m522_expect helper rejects symlinks. The configured dc_shell path is actually a symbolic link to snps_shell, so the exact-SHA runner deterministically exits 10 before synthesis. The observed resolved executable SHA does match the contract, but it is unreachable through the current preflight policy.
p0_findings.impact: The candidate is not executable; no canonical DC evidence can be produced.
p0_findings.minimum_fix: Do not weaken all evidence checks. Special-case the tool identity: either use the resolved regular path /opt/synopsys/syn/V-2023.12-SP3/bin/snps_shell, or pin and verify both the literal link target and the resolved regular-file SHA. Update contract and runner SHA pins, then repeat static review.

p0_findings.finding: The runner performs mv staging->canonical, sets m522_complete=1, and then verifies SHA256SUMS and its outer seal. If either final check fails, the EXIT trap sees complete=1 and does not quarantine the already published canonical directory.
p0_findings.impact: A failed run can occupy the canonical citeable path, violating fail-closed publication and one-shot retry semantics.
p0_findings.minimum_fix: Verify both seals while still in staging before the atomic mv. If a redundant post-move verification is retained, track an active_path that changes from staging to canonical and quarantine active_path on any failure; set complete=1 only after the final verification succeeds. Guard the quarantine destination against collision.

p1_findings.finding: DC normally treats pre-CTS clocks as ideal, but neither SDC/Tcl nor contract/receipt explicitly sets and audits ideal clock-network semantics.
p1_findings.minimum_fix: Set the clock network ideal explicitly and emit an audited report/receipt field proving ideal-clock analysis.

p1_findings.finding: The precompile TIM-209/OPT-150 counters scan only check_timing_precompile.rpt. check_design_precompile.rpt and a captured precompile link/elaboration transcript are not included; the shell's whole-log scan occurs only after compile has already run.
p1_findings.minimum_fix: Create a combined precompile transcript covering link/check_design/check_timing and scan that transcript plus both reports before ungroup/compile.

p1_findings.finding: The future receipt omits runner/RTL/filelist/SDC/Tcl/contract/tool/library hashes, SYNTHESIS/flatten/ideal flags, precompile counts, and five constraint-class counts. Several strings are hard-coded rather than cross-checked into the receipt.
p1_findings.minimum_fix: Add the frozen identities and gate results to the receipt, reject non-finite values, read the JSON back strictly, and assert the exact schema before sealing.

p1_findings.finding: The runner compares itself to caller-provided M522_EXPECTED_RUNNER_SHA256, but the contract does not freeze that SHA and input_sha256.txt/receipt do not record it. Recomputing the environment value after mutation would self-pass.
p1_findings.minimum_fix: Use the independently reviewed runner SHA as a literal launch requirement and persist the observed/expected runner SHA plus negative-preflight result in the canonical package.

p1_findings.finding: The hash manifest authenticates enumerated regular files but no exact file/type/link-target manifest rejects unexpected files, directories, or symlinks.
p1_findings.minimum_fix: Seal and validate an exact topology manifest or have the receipt-blind hammer compare the actual tree against an admitted exact population before citation.

p2_findings.finding: Hold uncertainty changes from 0.050 ns in SDC to 0.100 ns before hold fixing and 0.090 ns for publication timing, but only the contract documents the final value.
The PID-based quarantine destination is not checked for pre-existence before mv.

decision.required_re_review: Freeze a revised runner/contract after both P0 fixes, then perform a new exact-SHA receipt-blind static hammer before any DC execution.
decision.no_go_is_not_a_design_rejection: The RTL and M514 functional prerequisite remain eligible; this NO_GO concerns the M522 execution/evidence wrapper.
